integrity.basis: symbolic proof of edge constraints, squaring conjugacy, graph period and root-of-unity count
integrity.verification: standalone exact checker with 894 small graph/field cases, 156329 diagonal assignments and one perfect four-dimensional weighted example; finite checks corroborative, not infinite proof

scientific_limitations: Classification is only of operators diagonal in the fixed natural basis of an evolution algebra whose structure digraph is strongly connected and has at least one edge; arbitrary off-diagonal operators and general disconnected graphs are not classified.
title: The graph-period law for diagonal weight-one Rota–Baxter operators on evolution algebras
